messages:
julia: Heads-up — PR #4321 (migration guide -> v0.4) is ready for review. Need @matt for SDK snippets and @arjun for tone/terminology. CI preview is up but linkcheck failed.

matt: On my list, can take a pass this afternoon. What's the target merge window?

julia: Aiming EOD tomorrow if CI is green. Preview link: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/PR-4321 (note: linkcheck shows 2 failures).

docs-bot: docs preview built for PR #4321 — linkcheck: 2 broken links (./old-guides/convert, ./examples/python/old-snippet). Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/PR-4321/logs

arjun: I can review for voice. Quick note: 'we recommend' vs 'you should' inconsistent across migration steps. Suggest second-person active voice for quickstarts.

emily: Also spotted SDK differences: examples still show `client.generate()` in Python but v0.4 consolidated chat calls with `client.chat.create()`. We should standardize to chat.

julia: Good catch @emily — I left both to show parity, but agree we should pick one. @matt can you standardize to `client.chat.create()` and update the snippet blocks + call out the change in the migration note?

matt: Will do. Which pattern do we want for code comments — inline or block? I can also run prettier on the snippets.

arjun: Inline short comments are fine. Also small wording: change "the model will" -> "the model returns" in step 3.

julia: Added a tiny checklist in the PR description:
- update snippets to chat API
- fix broken links
- run preview and linkcheck
- address voice nits
Assigned @matt for code updates.

matt: Pushing commit now with snippet updates and a short changelog entry.

docs-bot: CI: docs-preview triggered for PR #4321. Lint: passed. Linkcheck: failing (./old-guides/convert). Rendering: table overflow warning on mobile for the "Compatibility" table.

julia: I'll remove the stale redirect and simplify the table. Anyone able to eyeball mobile table rendering after I push?

emily: I can check on mobile once preview rebuilds. Also leaving two inline comments about passive voice in the migration rationale.

matt: Fixes pushed. I replaced `client.generate()` with:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
response = client.chat.create(model="redwood-latest", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "..."}])
print(response.output_text)
```
Ran prettify.

docs-bot: Preview rebuilt for PR #4321 — all checks green ✅. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/PR-4321 (staging).

emily: Nice, preview looks good. Tone-wise: mostly second-person now, left 2 tiny comments for passive phrasing and a suggestion to reword a sentence for clarity.

arjun: Quick pass complete — approved from my side after the snippet change and the wording edits.

nancy: Pinging me for the enterprise/compliance paragraph — I'll review and get back by 4pm PST.

julia: Thanks @nancy. Who should merge once Nancy signs off? Do we want a final quick sanity check?

emily: I can do a final read for clarity post-signoff.

matt: Ready to approve & merge once Nancy gives the OK.

docs-bot: Merge window policy: minor docs PRs may merge during open window (today until 18:00 PST) if CI green and at least two reviewers approved.

arjun: Since I'm +1 and emily is +1, that'll meet the review count; Nancy's sign-off is for legal/compliance scope only.

nancy: Reviewed the compliance paragraph, small tweak applied inline. No blockers from my side.

emily: LGTM after nits.

julia: All right — merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:

docs-bot: PR #4321 merged by julia at 1912500360. Changelog entry queued.

Note: kept messages concise to mirror typical Slack review threads; main open items were snippet API change, link fixes, tone nits, and compliance sign-off — all resolved in this thread.
